values: 拉曼提斯指挥使徒控制敌人，随后对所有敌人造成高额伤害。
Lamentis commands his apostles to control enemies, then deals heavy damage to all enemies.
拉曼提斯的每名使徒各选择一名敌人，眩晕目标使其无法行动，持续3.5秒，优先选择最靠前的不同敌人。随后拉曼提斯对所有敌人造成600% + 60% ATK伤害，同时使徒对被牵制的敌人施加等同于拉曼提斯20%初始生命上限的生命削减。该技能释放结束后，拉曼提斯和使徒在接下来10秒内提高60点攻击速度。

Each of Lamentis' apostles targets an enemy and stuns them for 3.5s, prioritizing different frontmost enemies. Lamentis then deals 600% + 60% ATK damage to all enemies, while the apostles reduce the max HP of the stunned enemies by 20% of Lamentis' initial max HP. After casting this skill, Lamentis and his apostles gain 60 ATK SPD for 10s.
Increases the damage dealt to 640% + 60% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 680% + 60% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 720% + 60% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 760% + 60% ATK.
拉曼提斯每第3次普通攻击额外造成高额伤害。
Every third normal attack, Lamentis deals heavy extra damage.
拉曼提斯的每第3次普通攻击，投掷魔叉会附带魔力，造成210% + 30% ATK伤害，额外附带目标20% + 2%最大生命值的伤害（不超过240% + 30% ATK）。

Every third normal attack, Lamentis throws an enchanted trident, dealing 210% + 30% ATK damage plus extra damage equal to 20% + 2% of the target's max HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 240% + 30% ATK.
基础伤害量提高至220% + 30% ATK。
基础伤害量提高至230% + 30% ATK。
基础伤害量提高至240% + 30% ATK。
拉曼提斯消耗生命值召唤使徒协助作战。
Lamentis sacrifices HP to summon apostles to fight alongside him.

拉曼提斯消耗自身5%最大生命值，使用星云和粒子构造出2个持续12秒的使徒，使徒继承拉曼提斯45% + 6%的攻击力和80% + 8%的生命值，能使用普通攻击和碎星之手，并且优先攻击拉曼提斯当前攻击的目标。场上的使徒同时至多不超过6个。
若使徒存活至持续时间结束，则使徒会重新融合到拉曼提斯身上，使拉曼提斯回复等同于使徒在存活期间实际造成伤害80%的生命值。

Lamentis sacrifices 5% of his max HP to create 2 apostles from nebulae and particles. The apostles last 12s and inherit 45% + 6% of Lamentis' ATK and 80% + 8% of his HP. They can use normal attacks and Starcrusher, and prioritize attacking Lamentis' current target. Up to 6 apostles can exist on the battlefield at the same time.
If an apostle survives until its duration ends, it will merge back into Lamentis, healing him for HP equal to 80% of the actual damage the apostle dealt while it was active.
使徒继承的攻击力比例提高至50% + 6%。
Increases the ATK percentage inherited by the apostles to 50% + 6%.
使徒继承的攻击力比例提高至55% + 6%。
Increases the ATK percentage inherited by the apostles to 55% + 6%.
使徒继承的攻击力比例提高至60% + 6%。
Increases the ATK percentage inherited by the apostles to 60% + 6%.
拉曼提斯和使徒提高20点攻击速度，场上每存在1名自己的使徒，攻击速度额外提高3点。
Lamentis and his apostles gain 20 ATK SPD. This ATK SPD bonus increases by 3 for each of his apostles present on the battlefield.
拉曼提斯和使徒提高25点攻击速度，场上每存在1名自己的使徒，攻击速度额外提高4点。
Lamentis and his apostles gain 25 ATK SPD. This ATK SPD bonus increases by 4 for each of his apostles present on the battlefield.
拉曼提斯和使徒提高30点攻击速度，场上每存在1名自己的使徒，攻击速度额外提高5点。
Lamentis and his apostles gain 30 ATK SPD. This ATK SPD bonus increases by 5 for each of his apostles present on the battlefield.
使徒释放普通攻击时提升基础属性，并在融回拉曼提斯时提供对应的增益。
The apostles gain basic stat buffs when using normal attacks, and pass those buffs on to Lamentis when they merge back into him.
使徒每次释放普通攻击时获得1层“成长”，每层“成长”提高4%基础属性。在使徒力量融合回拉曼提斯时，使拉曼提斯获得其身上的“成长”。拉曼提斯至多获得20层“成长”。

Every time an apostle uses a normal attack, it gains 1 stack of Growth. Each stack of Growth increases basic stats by 4%. When an apostle's power merges back into Lamentis, Lamentis gains that apostle's Growth. Lamentis can have up to 20 stacks of Growth.
每次成长提供的基础属性提高至5%。
Increases the basic stats granted by each stack of Growth to 5%.
每次成长提供的基础属性提高至6%。
Increases the basic stats granted by each stack of Growth to 6%.
拉曼提斯通过该技能获得的“成长”达到上限后会睁开六眼，进入全盛姿态：在战斗中无需消耗地每间隔1秒生成使徒，直至达到上限。该状态下，拉曼提斯和使徒的“碎星之手”额外造成300% ATK真实伤害，使徒具备无限的持续时间，且拉曼提斯恢复相当于使徒实际造成伤害80%的生命值，及其获得能量的20%。进入全盛姿态后，拉曼提斯接下来6次普通攻击均替换为“碎星之手”。

When Lamentis reaches the maximum Growth stacks gained from this skill, he opens his Six Eyes and unlocks his full potential, allowing him to create apostles every 1s at no cost until the apostle limit is reached. While Lamentis' Six Eyes are active, Starcrusher cast by him and his apostles deals 300% ATK extra true damage, and the apostles no longer expire. Lamentis also recovers HP equal to 80% of the actual damage dealt by his apostles and gains 20% of the Energy they gain. Upon unlocking his full potential, his next 6 normal attacks are replaced by Starcrusher.
拉曼提斯会获得使徒身上的部分增益效果。
Lamentis gains part of the buffs applied to his apostles.
使徒受到其他友军提供的属性增益期间，额外使拉曼提斯也获得这部分10%的属性增益。
While an apostle has a stat buff from an ally other than Lamentis, Lamentis also gains 10% of that buff.
